notes: Four decks on their own MIDI channels: the controller switches them itself (DECK buttons; deck focus follows). SHIFT is modifier 1 (left) / 2 (right): SHIFT + jog searches (Mixxx: jog 100 times faster); most shifted buttons send other notes. Pad modes are modifiers 3-6 (decks 1-4; set in software by Mixxx): Hot Cue (held: preview; SHIFT deletes), Saved Loop (1 to 128 beats), Slicer (Mixxx's beat jumps: top row forward 1-8, bottom row back; SHIFT 16-128), Sampler and Velocity Sampler (samplers 1-8 for decks 1/3, deck C's cells; 9-16 for decks 2/4, deck D's; no velocity). VINYL toggles turntable / jog mode per deck (modifiers 7-10; it starts as turntable). Jogs: 894 counts per turn. Tempo fader: 14 bits (high CC 0x09, low CC 0x77), inverted as in Mixxx, with soft takeover. KEY: turn a semitone, push resets (held 350 ms here). RANGE ◀ ▶: the app's tempo range list (Mixxx 4-90 %). FX wet/dry encoders at Mixxx's step (2/64). Crossfader side switches: 1 = A, 2 = B, middle thru (as Mixxx's orientation values; which way is A not confirmed). Not mapped: Roll, Cue Loop, Flip, Slicer Loop and Pitch pad modes, play's brake / soft start with STOP TIME, SHIFT + CENSOR (spinback), SHIFT + CUE (start and stop), key sync, crossfader curve, needle search, parameter buttons (rating / colour), LOAD held (eject), sampler level, library sort and preview buttons, SHIFT + KEY (waveform zoom), jog ring, VU meters, the LEDs Mixxx turns down on quit. Not mapped from the Mixxx file: [PreviewDeckN] play, [ChannelN] start_stop, [ChannelN] beats_translate_curpos, [ChannelN] beats_translate_match_alignment, [Library] ScrollVertical, [Library] GoToItem, [Library] MoveFocusForward, [Library] MoveFocusBackward, [PreviewDeckN] LoadSelectedTrack, [EffectRackN] show, [EffectRackN_EffectUnitN] group_[Master]_enable, [EffectRackN_EffectUnitN] group_[Headphone]_enable, [ChannelN] sync_key.
